@vw2 1.4
@legend signpost: a verdict references its component recipe (ref=), never copies it
@legend q-vs-ran: q= is the REQUESTED quantity; ran= is the EXECUTED batch of the timing run
@legend metric: ns= is comparable only within identical metric= and units=; absent ns = informational
@legend lay: lay=split|il keys the CALLER's data layout (v1.2) - layout is a caller declaration like place=, never a strategy output; absent = a pre-1.2 record OR a shared-interior recipe (one engine serves both layouts - stamping a layout from the other door's timing would manufacture fake cells), served to concrete-lay requests as the fallback tier
@legend eng-on-nat: on ord=nat rows eng= names the WINNING family (zturn|k1|stride) since 2026-09-02; earlier rows carry eng=stride regardless (vintage, still served)
@legend wildcards: q=*/ord=*/place=* are migration-vintage only (from= required); fresh banks stamp concrete axes
@legend role: role=comp marks an engine-internal COMPONENT recipe; absent = the problem verdict at that key (equality-matched)
@legend isa: isa=avx2|avx512 keys the instruction set of the build that raced the row (v1.4); a build serves its own rows only and writes the others back as they are; absent = the isa= of the file's @meta (a file from before v1.4)
@legend evolution: new fields/axes land here as additive minor versions, never in frozen legacy files; reserved: sp_kv
@legend see src/core/wisdom2/README.md
